materials.title: Severable Protocol Connection and Integration Layer

paragraphs: A source capability may be registered as an addressable port while remaining disconnected. An interface contract defines possible binding and a distinct connection event records authorized use. Integration need not permanently merge apps.
A revocable route has a purpose, actor, approved scope, version, time, and evidence of establishment. Reversing the direction of a connection requires its own authorization.
A jack is not a cord and a cord is not a call. A tool listed in a registry is not proof the tool is available, authenticated, invoked, successful or semantically correct.
Historical execution receipts persist after the route or lease ends. Terminating a route does not delete the catalog, the app identity or past evidence.

materials.title: MCP Component Foundation: Registry Catalog and Context

paragraphs: A capability index card records owner service identity, tool name, interface version, schema, provenance, discovered status and supported input/output types.
A cataloged capability description is evidence of documented availability, not a grant of permission to execute it.
Corporate positions and agents are stored in Neon corporate records. Catalog card revisions are separate from evidence network nodes and relationships.
Context helps choose a capability but cannot overwrite the caller's authority or certify the factual truth of a claim.

materials.title: Dual Matrices: Application and Corporate Agent Switchboards

paragraphs: One matrix crosses applications with applications; another crosses corporate positions or agents with positions or agents. They answer different routing and jurisdiction questions.
The destination corporate seat must be registered and permitted by specific authority and service rules. An office title alone does not imply a running agent model.
A matrix cell models one directed pair binding and can be empty when no interface is available. Opposite directional cells may have different capabilities.
Two separately allowed edges do not automatically authorize an entire multi-hop path. An operator must inspect permissions, transformations and evidence at each hop.

materials.title: Contextual Buttons and Skills as Operational Protocol Logic

paragraphs: A contextually labeled button can represent a protocol binding among capabilities. Behind the button are input mapping, policy, ordered operations, errors and receipt output.
A skill is an instruction manual for choosing and sequencing possible tools; it is not itself a live connected tool or credential.
A protocol binding needs stable identity, version, source and destination capability IDs, preconditions, effect class, failure and compensation behavior.
A preposition in a dictionary definition can suggest a relation, but the preposition alone never proves a hypernym, causal claim or part-of link.

materials.title: Persistent System Entity Durable Agents and Corporate Routing

paragraphs: The parent System Entity Durable Object owns a stable operational identity while independently keyed Agent Durable Objects can preserve local checkpoints and message receipts.
A persistent runtime identity and stored organizational role do not by themselves demonstrate an independent reasoning model or approved agent authority.
Corporate message routing requires registered source and destination identities, an exact authorized direct office relationship, an enabled target service and an attributed message purpose.
A message delivery receipt means that a payload was received, not that the recipient understood it, reasoned about it or approved its factual claims.

materials.title: Neon Evidence Dictionary Body and OpenDiagram Cover

paragraphs: The Neon Catalog Box records revisioned index evidence cards and contextual definitions. The Neon Evidence Board stores typed claims, lexical senses, source nodes and versioned relationship evidence.
Words that share one dictionary definition are contextually related through that definition, but they are not necessarily hyponyms or part-of relatives.
OpenDiagram is the interactive Dictionary Cover. A source-only graph view should draw exactly those nodes and edges actually recorded in the Neon evidence network.

Rearranging graph shapes does not approve a semantic claim. Links in a visualization need provenance, source node IDs and epistemic status. Source-only indexer output must not be attributed to Echo's reasoning runtime.
